body:
**What is this feature?**

Preserve the `-- Dashboard --` datasource reference when exporting a v2 dashboard with “Share dashboard with another instance” enabled.

**Why do we need this feature?**

The exporter currently removes this reference as though it were an instance-specific datasource UID. After reimport, a panel that reuses another panel’s results can resolve to Grafana’s built-in datasource and display generated Random Walk data instead.

The Dashboard datasource uses a stable reference across installations. Keep it before generating datasource-remapping labels or removing UIDs. The change applies only to this exact reference; ordinary datasource anonymization, other built-in datasources, migrations, and datasource resolution retain their existing behavior.

**Who is this feature for?**

Users sharing v2 dashboards that reuse another panel’s query results through the Dashboard datasource.

**Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**

Fixes #126324
title: Dashboards: Preserve Dashboard datasource references in v2 exports
